params.prompt: Layered paper cutout animation, flat matte paper textures with soft shadows between layers. The wavy paper sea gently rises and falls. Star shapes twinkle softly. Thin lines connect the stars into a compass rose that slowly rotates; its needle stretches downward and becomes the small silhouette of a woman walking toward the horizon over the water. The deep navy sky is replaced layer by layer by dawn: bands of pale pink, warm yellow and soft mint paper slide up from the horizon until the whole sky is warm light. Static camera, no cuts, very slow continuous motion, handcrafted paper craft look, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
